title: Rav Ada son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 57b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.57b.12) according to Ein Yaakov, raising an objection to Rav Ashi; Hyman says the reading should be Rav Acha son of Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Rav Acha son of Rava addressing Rav Ashi. [Heilprin’s Rav Ada entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=213&lang=en) gives Adda for an exchange with Rav Ashi. Hyman attributes Ada to Ein Yaakov and says it should read Acha.
